body.message:
Good afternoon! A passport is all you need, no Emirates ID required.

The process is simple: you share a copy of your passport and your email, we send you a registration card to sign, then you receive your self-check-in details.

The security deposit for this unit is AED 2,000, fully refundable within 14 working days after check-out following a standard inspection.

What date are you looking to move in?
